name: Workbench
duplicates: Old UI (Figma 首页 › 工作台) has the same list as a default and an all-expanded state, plus Select language, Log out and an operation-result screen; none of those three are built in the prototype.
flow: tap the section name in the header
tap a task card that has no detail page (Pregnancy check)

notes.purpose: The first screen of the app: what needs doing now in the worker's section, task by task across all its units.

elements.name: Task card · state
elements.shows: Farrowing: "2 sows farrowing · 4 due today"; Piglet processing: "Next care · Tomorrow"

states.when: f.alert.count > 0 (a confirmed exception). No sample reaches it: Home never supplies alert
states.shows: Exception count and its label, rank 0

states.when: Farrowing only: at least one sow row in the scope is flagged active
states.shows: "N sows farrowing"; supporting line "N due today" when due > 0 (the "N past expected date" line needs a late count, which no sample supplies)

states.when: Farrowing, no live sow, late > 0. No sample reaches it: Home never supplies late
states.shows: "N sows past expected date" · "No final record"

states.when: Not farrowing and the due count in the scope is > 0
states.shows: "N <task label>" (sows ready to check, sows ready for service, litters with care due); one supporting line: pregnancy "N scheduled later" (unrecorded minus due), heat and return-heat "Current round", else none. Farrowing with no live sow: "N sows due today", no supporting line

states.when: Due > 0 and f.overdue > 0. No sample reaches it: Home never supplies overdue
states.shows: Supporting line "N past due" replaces the other line; rank 1

states.when: f.rechecks > 0, or f.first and f.repeat supplied. No sample reaches it
states.shows: "N rechecks due" (before "scheduled later"); breeding "N first · N repeat"

states.when: ?work=ready and the card has a completion bar (heat and return-heat are excluded)
states.shows: Quiet "All required work recorded", bar full, "Review & complete task" row; timing pill and footer hidden

states.when: Ready and closureBlockedBy is set. No sample reaches it
states.shows: "Waiting for <task> to close", quiet style

states.when: f.unitComplete is set. No sample reaches it
states.shows: "Unit work complete · task still open"

states.when: The card's preview state is waiting (Pregnancy Batch 32, Breeding, Piglet processing), ?work=waiting, or nothing is due or live in the scope (Farrowing in Unit 8)
states.shows: "<Next> · <time>": "Next care", "Next checks", "Next service", "Next expected", "Next check" + "Tomorrow" (nextAt of a day or more) or hh:mm; no count, sorted under "Next"

states.when: Nothing due and no nextLabel. No sample reaches it: every sample card has a nextAt
states.shows: "Waiting for heat confirmations" (breeding), "Waiting for next scheduled care" (piglet), "Waiting for farrowing records" (postpartum), else "No work due now"

states.when: Heat or return-heat card whose preview state is round-complete (Return-heat Batch 30, Heat Batch 35) or ?work=round-complete
states.shows: "Round complete · Next check · 14:30", no progress bar. Other tasks fall back to Waiting

states.when: completedAt or terminatedAt is set
states.shows: Compact receipt at the bottom (see Closed task card)

elements.logic: Evaluated in this order: closed, alert, task-specific work due, ready, unit complete, next scheduled action. A full bar, a finished unit or one full session never proves the whole task is ready. Home's sample data forces Piglet processing to "Waiting" (cardFields.piglet27.state) so its due counts of 2 + 2 are ignored unless ?work=active.
elements.rule: Counts are unique animals or litters in the selected scope, never procedures. The headline is what is actionable now; it is not total minus completed when eligibility depends on time.

elements.name: Task card · headline and supporting line
elements.logic: Value = sum of the sample "due" counts over the scope (Farrowing due {6:2, 7:2, 8:0}); "live" = the next unrecorded sow in each unit except Unit 8, so Overview 2, Unit 6 1, Unit 7 1, Unit 8 none. Only one supporting line is shown, by task: pregnancy and postpartum "N rechecks due" else "N scheduled later" (unrecorded minus due); breeding "N first · N repeat"; heat and return-heat "Current round". Label takes the singular for 1 ("1 sow farrowing"). With no live sow, due today becomes the headline with no supporting line; with nothing due the card is Waiting.

elements.name: Task card · progress bar
elements.logic: Named aggregate progress: items with a recorded result over all items in the scope (Farrowing Overview 7/18, Unit 6 4/8, Unit 7 1/6, Unit 8 2/4; Piglet processing counts pens, 1/8). Bar width = value/total. Home forces a plain completion bar even where the task itself shows a distribution. Heat and return-heat have no completion bar, and "recorded in heat" is an outcome, not progress. The bar is hidden on upcoming cards.

elements.name: Task card · timing pill and footer
elements.shows: Day 2 of 7 · Across 3 units · View task
elements.logic: The pill is the position in the batch window (cardFields day, days), "Today" when the window is one day; it is context, not a completion measure, and not the litters' own age. It is hidden on a Ready card. "Across N units" = units that carry the task (not units with work due); in a unit scope the footer is replaced by an arrow in the header and the card opens that unit's task.

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading and card order
elements.logic: Cards sort by attention rank: live farrowing or alert 0, overdue 1, due 2, ready to complete 2.5, waiting 3 (earliest next event first), closed 4. Equal ranks keep their order so the list does not jump. "Next" is printed once above the first quiet card (waiting, round complete or upcoming).

elements.name: Saved-work card
elements.shows: 3 records saved on this device · No connection · waiting to upload

states.when: Records are queued and there is no connection (the page starts here with 3 sample records)
states.shows: Top card: "N records saved on this device" · "No connection · waiting to upload"

states.when: Queued and a connection is available
states.shows: "Connection available · tap to upload"

states.when: An upload started and failed
states.shows: "Upload interrupted · tap to retry"

states.when: An upload is running
states.shows: "Uploading N records" · "Sending saved work…"

states.when: Nothing is waiting
states.shows: Moves to the bottom of the list: "All records uploaded · No records waiting on this device"

elements.logic: The queue is fictional (three samples). Nothing the other prototypes record feeds it.

elements.name: Section and unit scope
elements.logic: Section on first load = URL `section` when valid, else the last one picked (localStorage sentri-home-prototype-section; ignored if storage is blocked), else Gestation. The second scope button reads "Choose unit" with no unit chosen and "Unit N" with one; the small figure is the number of units in the section (Farrowing 6, 7, 8; Gestation 7, 8, 9; Breeding 1-4; Nursery 12, 13). Choosing a unit re-runs every card rule on that unit's figures; whole-task closure stays global.

elements.name: Closed task card
elements.shows: Piglet processing · Batch 26 · Across 3 units · Completed · Today, 09:10

states.when: completedAt is set on the instance
states.shows: Check icon, title, batch (and scope in the Overview), "Completed · <stamp>"

states.when: terminatedAt is set (End task early)
states.shows: Stop icon and "Ended early · <stamp>"

elements.logic: Closed cards collect at the bottom under "Closed tasks N" (N = closed instances in the scope), always sort last, and never show due counts again, even if old records would say otherwise.

copy: (raw) every string on Home is literal in home-astra-prototype.js and astra-home-task-card.js; none uses ux/laws/strings.json yet
edge: A section with no tasks shows the quiet empty state (Nursery, see workbench.quiet-section).
A unit that does not carry a task hides that task's card.
issues: The date "Thu, 8 Jul" is fixed sample text, while the piglet-processing prototype uses the real clock.
"Across 3 units" counts units that carry the task, not units with work due, and repeats on every card.
The Piglet card mixes litters ("4 litters with care due") and pens ("1 / 8 pens"). A pen is a litter in the prototype.
The Piglet card says Batch 27, 8 pens, care due tomorrow; the prototype it opens starts on Batch 40, 12 pens, 6 due today.
The saved-work card sits first while offline and pushes the day's work down; its queue is fictional.
`layout=focus` has no effect on Home; it is only forwarded to detail pages.
No way to reach language or log out (the old Figma has both).

notes.purpose: Pick one unit of the section to narrow every count to that unit.

elements.name: Unit row

states.when: The unit has unrecorded rows in at least one open task
states.shows: "N tasks" (singular "1 task")

states.when: No open task has unrecorded rows in the unit
states.shows: "No tasks"; the unit is still listed

states.when: A unit is already chosen
states.shows: aria-current on its row; the direction doc asks for a tint and check, the code sets only the attribute

elements.logic: The count is open tasks in the section with unrecorded rows in this unit, so a waiting task counts and can disagree with the cards the unit screen shows. Pigs and pens come from units{}; in the Farrowing section they are overridden (Unit 6: 8 pigs, 4 pens; Unit 7: 7, 4; Unit 8: 4, 2) to match the Farrowing prototype.
elements.rule: All units of the section are listed with no search (about 15 at most). Choosing a unit narrows counts, not batch time.

copy: (raw) Farrowing units · All 3 units · Unit 6 · 8 pigs · 4 pens · 2 tasks · Back
edge: Units with no tasks still appear.
issues: "2 tasks" counts tasks with unrecorded rows, waiting ones included; the label does not say what it counts.

notes.purpose: A quiet view across the farm to choose where to work.

elements.name: Section card
elements.shows: Gestation · 3 units · 246 pigs · 2 task types ready

states.when: It is the section the worker is in
states.shows: Check mark; others show an arrow

states.when: At least one task type in the section has unrecorded rows
states.shows: "N task types ready" (waiting tasks with unrecorded rows count as ready)

states.when: No task type has unrecorded rows (Nursery)
states.shows: "No scheduled work today"

elements.logic: Units = units in the section; pigs = a fixed population per section; task types = distinct task types with unrecorded rows (pendingTypes), not work due now.
elements.rule: Selecting a section clears the unit, remembers the section on the device and opens its Overview.

edge: A section with no scheduled work still opens, to a quiet empty state.
issues: "task types ready" counts waiting tasks as ready; it says nothing about work due now.
The footer note and intro repeat the choice the cards already make.

notes.purpose: The same Overview in a section that shows several card states at once.

elements.name: Pregnancy check card
elements.shows: 5 sows ready to check · 7 scheduled later · 8 / 20 sows

states.when: Check windows are open
states.shows: "N sows ready to check" = sum of due {7:2, 8:2, 9:1}; supporting line "N scheduled later" (unrecorded 12 minus due 5)

states.when: Nothing due, next check known (Batch 32)
states.shows: "Next checks · Tomorrow", 0 / 8 sows

elements.logic: Supporting line priority: overdue checks, then due rechecks, then scheduled later; only the first applies and rechecks are inside the main count. A full first-check bar does not complete later checks.

elements.name: Return-heat card

states.when: The round was explicitly closed (cardFields.return30.state)
states.shows: Quiet line with a check, no progress bar

states.when: Sows within their window still need the observation
states.shows: "N sows to check" · "Current round"

elements.rule: Only explicit activity marks a round complete. No return and a blank mark are not evidence of a completed or negative observation. No Home progress bar, return rate or elapsed-time bar.

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading and card order
elements.logic: Cards sort by attention rank: live farrowing or alert 0, overdue 1, due 2, ready to complete 2.5, waiting 3 (earliest next event first), closed 4. Equal ranks keep their order so the list does not jump. "Next" is printed once above the first quiet card (waiting, round complete or upcoming).

elements.shows: Piglet processing · Batch 26 · Across 3 units · Completed · Today, 09:10

states.when: completedAt is set on the instance
states.shows: Check icon, title, batch (and scope in the Overview), "Completed · <stamp>"

states.when: terminatedAt is set (End task early)
states.shows: Stop icon and "Ended early · <stamp>"

notes.purpose: Shows the Overview when every task has work due now.

elements.name: Piglet processing card · due

states.when: ?work=active (or the Work preview select outside the phone)
states.shows: "N litters with care due" = sum of cardFields.piglet27.due {6:2, 7:2}; singular "1 litter with care due"

states.when: Default
states.shows: "Next care · Tomorrow", due counts ignored

elements.rule: Count unique litters, not procedures. A supporting line would be litters with overdue required care; Home supplies none.

issues: "Due now" exists only in the card's accessible name; visually the pill still says "Day 3 of 7".

notes.purpose: Shows the cards that are ready to be completed by the worker.

elements.name: Ready card
elements.shows: All required work recorded · Review & complete task

states.when: ?work=ready: the card has a completion bar
states.shows: Quiet "All required work recorded", full bar, "Review & complete task" row; timing pill and footer hidden

states.when: Heat and return-heat have no completion bar
states.shows: Unchanged ("10 sows to check · Current round")

states.when: closureBlockedBy is set. No sample reaches it: Home never sets it
states.shows: "Waiting for <task> to close" instead

elements.rule: A full bar never proves readiness by itself; dependencies and future required work must be checked. Closure is whole-task and stays global, not scope-dependent.

issues: The dependency wait ("Waiting for farrowing to close") is coded but no sample reaches it.

notes.purpose: What the Overview shows when a section has no task today.

elements.name: Empty state

states.when: The scoped task list is empty (Nursery)
states.shows: "No scheduled tasks today", "Select a unit to inspect pens or record anything you find." and a Tomorrow card

states.when: A unit is chosen and carries no task
states.shows: "You can still inspect this unit and record anything you find."; the Tomorrow card is hidden

elements.logic: The Tomorrow card (Growth check · Batch 26 · Units 12-13) is fixed sample text, not derived from any task.

edge: Units 12 and 13 still have environment and device access.
issues: The Tomorrow card is hard-coded text, not derived from any task.

screens.name: Unit · Gestation Unit 7
screens.zh: 单元 · 妊娠 7 单元

notes.purpose: The same Home narrowed to one unit: its facts, its entrances (inspect, environment) and only its tasks.

elements.name: Unit hub · attention chips

states.when: A signal is above zero
states.shows: A chip per signal with its count

states.when: All signals are zero
states.shows: "No flagged items"

states.when: The summary could not be read
states.shows: "Health and feed summary unavailable"; never shown as zero

elements.logic: Health and Feed are fictional snapshot counts chosen by the `attention` preview (current, clear, health, feed, maintenance, busy, unknown) and are the same in every unit. Maintenance = open maintenance records of the unit.

elements.name: Unit hub · Checked
elements.logic: First segment of units[N].checked (the part before the name). Date and checker are sample data; who checked is dropped.

states.when: The unit has at least one numeric reading
states.shows: The readings that exist (temperature, humidity, ammonia)

states.when: No readings but a controllable device
states.shows: "N devices" (singular "1 device")

states.when: No reading and no device (all Farrowing and Breeding units of the sample)
states.shows: The card is not drawn

elements.name: Task cards in a unit
elements.shows: Pregnancy check · 2 sows ready to check · 2 scheduled later · 2 / 6 sows
elements.logic: The Overview rules re-run on the unit's figures; the footer is replaced by an arrow; tasks without the unit are hidden.

elements.name: Coming up
elements.logic: Collapsed list of the unit's next batches or rounds (Batch 31 Pregnancy check · tomorrow; Batch 30 Return-heat · 14:30). Not shown in the Farrowing section, which has no unit context.

edge: A unit with no readings and no device has no environment card.
issues: The same Health 3 / Feed 3 snapshot appears in every unit.
The Maintenance chip sits inside the Inspect card but opens Inspection, not Maintenance; the list is only reachable via Toolbox.
"Checked Yesterday" drops who checked and when; the direction doc says the strip shows last-check time.

screens.name: Unit · Farrowing Unit 6
screens.zh: 单元 · 产房 6 单元

notes.purpose: A unit of the Farrowing section: the card the worker opens to continue in this unit.

elements.name: Unit cards by unit
elements.shows: Unit 6: 1 sow farrowing · 2 due today · 4 / 8 sows; Piglet processing Next care · Tomorrow, 1 / 4 pens

states.when: Live sow, 2 due
states.shows: Farrowing active "1 sow farrowing · 2 due today", 4 / 8 sows; Piglet processing waiting, 1 / 4 pens

states.when: Live sow, 2 due
states.shows: Farrowing "1 sow farrowing · 2 due today", 1 / 6 sows

states.when: No live sow, nothing due, no Piglet task
states.shows: Farrowing waiting "Next expected · Tomorrow", 2 / 4 sows; no Piglet card

elements.logic: No environment card and no Coming up: currentUnitContext() returns nothing for the Farrowing section.

issues: The Farrowing units show no environment or maintenance entrance although farrowing rooms carry sensors in the old design.
Opening Piglet processing passes unit=6 and returnUnit=6, which the prototype ignores.

notes.purpose: Shows what is saved on the phone and not yet sent, and lets the worker upload it.

elements.name: Upload button and message
elements.shows: Upload 3 records · No connection · check Wi-Fi or mobile signal

states.when: No connection (default; "Connection preview" select outside the phone)
states.shows: "3 records waiting to upload", button "Upload 3 records"; pressing it reports "Still no connection. All 3 records remain on this device."

states.when: Connected, records waiting
states.shows: Upload icon; button uploads

states.when: About 0.9 s after pressing
states.shows: Button "Uploading…" disabled, "Uploading saved records…"

states.when: The simulated upload fails
states.shows: "Upload did not complete. Your records are still on this device. Try again." with "Retry upload"

states.when: Queue empty
states.shows: "Everything is uploaded", "There are no records waiting on this device.", button "Done"

elements.rule: Only a successful upload clears the queue; a failure keeps every record. The drawer separates records saved on this device from records uploaded for the team.

elements.name: Record row
elements.logic: Task, animal, place and save time of a queued record. Three fictional samples; nothing the other screens do feeds this queue.

issues: The offline queue is entirely simulated: records made in the other prototypes never appear here.
unclear: where the old Figma data-sync list and detail (数据同步) fit relative to this drawer.

notes.purpose: Placeholder page for every task that has no detail design yet; the task stays open between scheduled work.

elements.name: Title and subtitle

states.when: Opened from the Overview
states.shows: Subtitle ends " · All units"

states.when: Opened inside a unit
states.shows: Subtitle ends " · Unit N"

elements.logic: Only Farrowing and Piglet processing hand off to real prototypes; every other task lands here.

issues: The page does not say what the task is or show any of its work; it is a stand-in.
The wording differs from the research name ("Not designed yet").

notes.purpose: The page behind a ready card: lets the worker complete the whole task.

elements.name: Complete task
elements.logic: Enabled only when the card's model state is ready. Sets completedAt "Today · just now" and returns to Home, where the card joins Closed tasks.
elements.rule: Completion is explicit; nothing closes automatically, and it stays inside the task overview.

issues: No review of what is being completed; the rules ask for a review before closing.

notes.purpose: Confirms ending a task before its work is complete.

elements.name: End task early
elements.logic: Sets terminatedAt "Today · just now". Existing records are kept and unfinished work stays incomplete; the card then shows under Closed tasks as "Ended early".
elements.rule: Consequences must be shown inside each task (batch membership, backfill); this drawer states none.

issues: The drawer states no consequence for the task (the rules say each task must).

notes.purpose: Read-only page for a completed or ended task.

elements.name: Receipt

states.when: completedAt is set
states.shows: Check icon, "Task complete", subtitle "· Completed", the stamp

states.when: terminatedAt is set
states.shows: "Task ended early", subtitle "· Ended early", the stamp

elements.logic: The stamp is the instance's completedAt or terminatedAt string. "Results page not designed yet." is a stub.

issues: The results page is a stub ("Results page not designed yet").

notes.purpose: Lets the worker choose a language and log out. Not built.
states: Not built: the old design (Figma 首页 › 工作台) has Select language, Log out and an operation-result screen; the Home prototype has neither control nor an entry.
